question: Start-up culture has grown rapidly in India after the liberalisation. Which ministry leads the implementation of the Start-up India initiative?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Commerce and Industry**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The **Ministry of Commerce and Industry** leads the implementation of the Start-up India initiative under the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT).
 
• The Start-up India initiative was launched by **Prime Minister Narendra Modi on January 16, 2016**, to boost entrepreneurship in India.
